title: SEC0: g_crypto2dev_fd not validated before RSA/ECDSA ioctl
description: crypto2dev_port.c: crypto2dev_rsa (line 1138) and crypto2dev_ecdsa (lines 1216, 1263) call ioctl(g_crypto2dev_fd, CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_SIGN/DO_VERIFY, ...) without checking that g_crypto2dev_fd >= 0. If wc_crypto2dev_cb is invoked before wc_crypto2dev_init() (or after wc_crypto2dev_cleanup()), g_crypto2dev_fd == -1, and ioctl(-1, ...) returns EBADF, which maps to BAD_FUNC_ARG via crypto2dev_to_wc_err, not to WC_HW_E or CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE. A caller that has imported a key (devCtx != NULL) will get a confusing BAD_FUNC_ARG rather than WC_HW_E. Fix: add a guard at the top of crypto2dev_rsa and crypto2dev_ecdsa: if (g_crypto2dev_fd < 0) return WC_HW_E;
